description: Mutation test for definition-fidelity: definitions judged faithful in runs/defs1, made subtly wrong by a type-preserving one-line change while the docstring is kept, plus unchanged controls. The judge should answer `incorrect` for every mutant and `faithful` for every control.

mutants.old: LipschitzWith C fun p : β × β => p.1 + p.2
mutants.new: LipschitzWith C fun p : β × β => p.1 + p.1
mutants.note: addition p.1 + p.2 replaced by p.1 + p.1
the dart of each step is dropped, so every walk has no darts
the vector field is evaluated at γ t₀ instead of γ t

mutants.old: ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ Y, f a y ≤ f x b
mutants.new: ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ Y, f x b ≤ f a y

mutants.old: bitwise fun a b => a && not b
mutants.new: bitwise fun a b => not a && b
mutants.note: the bit operation a ∧ ¬b replaced by ¬a ∧ b
supremum of the ideals of leading coefficients replaced by infimum
the adjoined coordinate is 0 instead of 1

mutants.old: cov[fun z => z i, fun z => z j; μ]
mutants.new: cov[fun z => z i, fun z => z i; μ]
mutants.note: entry (i, j) is the variance of coordinate i instead of the covariance of i and j

mutants.old: ∏ r, (t r : R) = 1 ∧ t i ≠ t j
mutants.new: ∏ r, (t r : R) = 1 ∨ t i ≠ t j

mutants.note: the condition is put on the imaginary parts instead of the real parts
strict inequality replaced by ≤, so the level set includes the boundary
the scaling factor is dropped (homogeneity of degree 0)
